label: Cancellation Rate
description: Percentage of bookings that were cancelled.
formula_plain_english: percentage of bookings where transaction_status is a cancelled value
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN {{transaction_status}} IN {{cancelled_values}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN {{transaction_status}} IN {{cancelled_values}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_bookings, COUNT(*) AS total_bookings FROM {{fact}}
